question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Normally**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Normally **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• It is an adverb that means usually or in a normal manner. (आमतौर पर या सामान्य तरीके से)
 
 
• **Example**: *Normally, I have my morning coffee with a splash of cream.*
 
 
 
• It fits well in the sentence and makes grammatical sense.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Remotely **means from a distance. (एक दूरी से)
 
• **Excitedly **means in an excited manner. (उत्साहित तरीके से)
 
• **Intermittently** means occasionally or sporadically. (कभी-कभी या छिटपुट रूप से)
